claims_allowed: Unchanged-physics external disturbances produce the recorded paired plug-in-gripper drift.
claims_not_allowed: Requested force direction equals actual drift direction.
Pilot bounds estimate a real-world disturbance distribution.

source.force_onset: first integrator substep after the completed anchor frame
source.force_frame: gripper-local XY transformed by the instantaneous gripper rotation every substep
source.zero_force_pairing: matched branch from the same frame-97 integration state and frozen suffix actions

broad_exploration.domain: 5-25 N, 50-200 ms, three requested phases, continuous random angle
broad_exploration.limit: Stopped at retreat and measured within-branch settling; used only to choose the corrected focused wave.

corrected_focused_wave.domain: lift-middle, 10 N, 50 ms, full continuous angle
corrected_focused_wave.selection: The 0.95-1.35 rad interval contained valid successes and failures with penetration margin.

fresh_freeze_validation.domain: lift-middle, 8 N, 50 ms, equal mixture of uniform angles -0.28--0.268 and 1.05-1.08 rad

first_candidate_validation.domain: lift-middle, 10 N, 50 ms, uniform angle 0.95-1.35 rad
first_candidate_validation.reason: All conditions were valid but the 87.5% success rate was weaker than the preferred mixed challenge.

second_candidate_validation.domain: lift-middle, 10 N, 50 ms, uniform angle 0.98-1.05 rad
second_candidate_validation.reason: A near-identical angle crossed the collision limit, exposing an unsafe contact bifurcation.

third_candidate_validation.domain: lift-middle, 10 N, 50 ms, equal mixture of uniform angles 0.978-0.998 and 1.12-1.20 rad
third_candidate_validation.reason: The positive failure interval still contained a narrow collision island.

fourth_candidate_validation.domain: lift-middle, 10 N, 50 ms, equal mixture of uniform angles -0.32--0.28 and 1.25-1.33 rad
fourth_candidate_validation.reason: The negative failure interval also contained a collision bifurcation; force magnitude required refinement.

magnitude_refinement.domain: lift-middle, 50 ms, 8 N versus 9 N in two sensitive angle bands
magnitude_refinement.selection: 8 N retained valid failures and a stable success band; 9 N negative-direction samples crossed the collision limit.
